purpose: Ensure future archive passes use web verification for volatile/current claims.
web_required_for: current model availability, rankings, release dates, licenses, benchmark claims
software API, ComfyUI custom-node, workflow JSON, node class, installation, registry, and migration claims
hardware specs, cloud pricing, TCO, performance-per-dollar, performance-per-watt claims
security, safety, governance, academic/publication policy, legal, licensing, and compliance claims
answer_gate: If a claim is volatile and not web-verified, qualify it or keep it out of canonical answers.
override_note: Temporary previous no-web instructions are not standing policy. Use web unless the user explicitly opts out.
